# iosxe_voice_translation_rule (Resource)

This resource can manage the Voice Translation Rule configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iosxe_voice_translation_rule" "example" {
  tag = 200
  rules = [
    {
      rule_id                      = 1
      matching_replacement_pattern = "/408/ /555/"
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tag` (Number) - Range: `1`-`1073741823`

### Optional

- `delete_mode` (String) Configure behavior when deleting/destroying the resource. Either delete the entire object (YANG container) being managed, or only delete the individual resource attributes configured explicitly and leave everything else as-is. Default value is `all`.
  - Choices: `all`, `attributes`
- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.
- `rules` (Attributes List) Translation rule (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The path of the object.

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Required:

- `rule_id` (Number) Translation rule number
  - Range: `1`-`100`

Optional:

- `matching_replacement_pattern` (String) Matching and replacement pattern, i.e., /xxx/ /xxx/
- `reject` (String) Call block rule

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import iosxe_voice_translation_rule.example "<tag>"
```
